text: My turn. Jed gave me the backstory. I'm not singing the backstory. I'm singing the watching. We are all watching and waiting. That's a debt. You watch a man miss a fish, you've paid something. You watch him not care that he missed it, you've paid something else.
He reaches for the gaff, and it's only a pink!
That's the verse. The smallest fish in the sea, and he treats it like it owes him a conversation. I'm going to bend the note until it admits it.
